source.check: name and division read from the official notice on the page image (no votes recorded against him); returned unopposed, no poll

note: Triennial election of the rural district council (29 divisions), 1964: sixteen contests at the close of nominations, fifteen after the withdrawal of Bernard Murphy in Belleek, polled 4 June 1964. Returned unopposed. The sitting member, Bernard J. McVerry, retired; Bernard Murphy and Robert McGuinness (of Lisadian, Whitecross) were nominated and Murphy withdrew, leaving McGuinness returned unopposed: the official notice of result lists him for Belleek with no votes recorded.
